description: Despite the name, this works for any private ask (post_ask, an open call or a pro ask), not only calls. The list of an ask as the poster sees it (pass its number as collectionId): every invitation (address, handle or link, and whether a link was opened), every application and its decision, and the links minted here (including those post_ask made) so they can be handed out again. Spends nothing.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

slug.description: The call's name, for a call posted from this machine.
